messages:
tara (AE): Heads-up — ValenceHealth sent an RFP this morning. They want a consolidated capability matrix, a filled security questionnaire, and a POC plan by EOD Friday. Can we split tasks? :wave:
maria (AM): I can own the security questionnaire draft. Do we have their template? link: https://valencehealth.example.com/rfp/attachments (they attached a spreadsheet)
jeff (SE): I can do the capability matrix + short tech writeup. Need confirmation on which model variants we should commit to for POC (redwood-llm-xt, redwood-llm-large, and an 8-bit quantized flavor?).
lin (Solutions Eng): For the POC plan I'll sketch env/infra, data connectors, and success criteria. Question: do they need on-prem option tested or only VPC? Their RFP says preferred: VPC, optional on-prem airgap.
tara (AE): VPC first. On-prem only if they sign the MSA. For now include on-prem as a phased item in the POC appendix.
maria (AM): Uploaded security Qs to our drive: capsec_valence_qs_v1.xlsx. I'll mark yes/no and add notes for items we need legal for.
jeff (SE): Drafted capability matrix skeleton and shared: cap_matrix_valence_v1.xlsx. Columns: feature, supported by Redwood, config notes, latencies (p95), limits, KMS/HSM support. Need latency numbers from infra team.
lin (Solutions Eng): I can run a quick throughput/latency check against our dev cluster for the three variants. Will paste small test harness below.
lin (Solutions Eng): ```bash
# quick curl to hosted dev endpoint (token redacted)
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEV_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-llm-xt","input":"short prompt","max_tokens":64}' \
  https://api.dev.redwood.ai/v1/generate | jq -r '.latency_ms'
```
jeff (SE): Perfect. Send results as p50/p95 and peak RPS sample. I'll slot them into the matrix. Also add a row for streaming vs non-streaming throughput.
ops-bot: Note: There is a DLP review checkbox that legal needs to sign off on for healthcare customers when PHI is in scope. Creating ticket INF-8143 and pinging legal.
maria (AM): Thanks — I flagged PHI in the questionnaire and added a comment that DLP/legal must confirm retention policy.
tara (AE): Pricing — Valence asked for committed capacity pricing tiers (monthly committed GPUs) + an example POC estimate for 30 days at 4x A100-equivalent. Jeff, can you sketch the committed estimate? Use our standard table and include burst pricing.
jeff (SE): I'll produce a quick pricing worksheet. Rough numbers (ballpark) — committed: $X/month per A100-equivalent, burst surcharge 25%. I'll finalize after infra confirms the instance mix.
lin (Solutions Eng): Latency run complete. redwood-llm-xt: p50 38ms, p95 92ms, sample peak RPS 90. redwood-llm-large: p50 120ms, p95 270ms, sample peak RPS 40. quant-8bit: p50 46ms, p95 110ms, sample peak RPS 75. Posting raw logs to drive: rv_latency_runs/3967004321_logs.txt
jeff (SE): Nice. Inserting those numbers into cap_matrix_valence_v2.xlsx and adding a row for KV-cache warm/cold behavior.
maria (AM): Security Q notes: they request BYOK with HSM. We support KMS integrations (AWS/GCP/Azure) — HSM on-prem requires private deployment + add-on. Marked as "supported via Private / add-on" in sheet.
tara (AE): Action items: 1) Jeff finalize matrix + tech writeup (owner: jeff) 2) Maria finish security Qs and escalate legal items (owner: maria) 3) Lin produce infra runbook and simple deployment template for VPC POC (owner: lin) 4) Me — compile deliverables and send RFP response Friday AM.
lin (Solutions Eng): I'll add a small terraform snippet to the repo for the VPC topology and a checklist for network peering and routes.
jeff (SE): Quick note for the matrix: include a small compatibility cell for model fallbacks and automatic routing (hosted->dedicated->private). Valence asked about SLAs for latency — include our standard SLA verbiage and exceptions.
ara (Legal): @maria (AM) seeing INF-8143, adding legal review. Expect turnaround ~48h, will call out retention and incident reporting language.
maria (AM): Thanks @ara. I put a red highlight on retention questions so legal sees them immediately.
tara (AE): If we can get matrix + security Qs by Thursday EOD we can package the POC plan with pricing on Friday. Any blockers?
jeff (SE): No blockers from my side, just waiting on any legal clarifications for HSM wording.
lin (Solutions Eng): No infra blockers — will hand off deployment template by Thursday noon.
maria (AM): I'll finish the questionnaire draft tonight and drop PDF into the thread: security_qs_filled_valence_v1.pdf.
tara (AE): Great. Once all pieces in drive, I'll assemble and send to Valence with the email template below — feel free to tweak.
jeff (SE): Can you paste the template?
tara (AE): "Hi Valence team — thanks for the RFP. Attached: capability matrix, security questionnaire, POC plan, pricing worksheet, and deployment checklist. We propose kickoff week of MM/DD. Please confirm acceptance or share availability for a 30-minute technical alignment call. Best, Tara (Redwood)"
maria (AM): Added a note in the PDF that the security answers are based on VPC workflow; on-prem details are in the POC appendix.
tara (AE): OK team — owners, update the shared drive files and drop final pointers here by Thu EOD. We'll reconvene 9am Friday to finalize. :thumbsup:
